cards.example_en: We showed our passports at the border this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上我们在边界出示了护照。

cards.example_en: The boys grew bored halfway through the long assembly.
cards.example_zh: 冗长的集会进行到一半，男孩们就感到无聊了。

cards.example_en: We visited the botanical garden.
cards.example_zh: 我们参观了植物园。

cards.example_en: Don't bother Dad while he is cooking dinner.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸做晚饭的时候别打扰他。

cards.example_en: The basketball will bounce off the gym wall.
cards.example_zh: 篮球会从体育馆的墙上反弹回来。

cards.example_en: She felt bound to return the wallet she found on the bus.
cards.example_zh: 她觉得必须把在公交车上捡到的钱包还回去。

cards.example_en: A fence marks the boundary of the school field.
cards.example_zh: 一道篱笆标出了学校操场的边界。

cards.example_en: The violin bow slipped from her hand during practice.
cards.example_zh: 练习时，小提琴的琴弓从她手里滑了下去。

cards.example_en: Bowling is popular at the weekend.
cards.example_zh: 周末打保龄球很流行。

cards.example_en: Boxing practice left his arms sore and tired.
cards.example_zh: 拳击训练让他的两条胳膊又酸又累。

cards.example_en: The sports branch of the club meets on Saturdays.
cards.example_zh: 俱乐部的体育部门每星期六开会。

cards.example_en: The baby rested against his mother's breast.
cards.example_zh: 宝宝靠着妈妈的前胸休息。

cards.example_en: Breathe deeply and try to relax.
cards.example_zh: 深呼吸，尽量放松。

cards.example_en: Workers laid each brick carefully along the wall.
cards.example_zh: 工人们沿着墙把每块砖都仔细砌好。

cards.example_en: The bride smiled as she walked into the hall.
cards.example_zh: 新娘微笑着走进了大厅。

cards.example_en: The bridegroom waited at the front.
cards.example_zh: 新郎在前面等候。

cards.example_en: The principal gave a brief welcome before the concert started.
cards.example_zh: 音乐会开始前，校长做了简短的欢迎。

cards.example_en: What a brilliant idea!
cards.example_zh: 真是个绝妙的主意！

cards.example_en: A broad path leads from the gate to the sports field.
cards.example_zh: 一条宽阔的小路从大门通向运动场。

cards.example_en: The station will broadcast the game live.
cards.example_zh: 电台将直播这场比赛。

cards.example_en: I picked up a travel brochure at the station.
cards.example_zh: 我在车站拿了一本旅游宣传册。

cards.example_en: Lunch is a buffet in the dining hall.
cards.example_zh: 午餐在食堂是自助餐。

cards.example_en: She bought a bunch of flowers.
cards.example_zh: 她买了一束花。

cards.example_en: The dog tried to bury its bone in the garden.
cards.example_zh: 那只狗想把骨头埋进花园里。

cards.example_en: The butcher cut the meat for our family dinner.
cards.example_zh: 屠夫为我们的家庭晚餐切好了肉。

cards.example_en: A button fell off my coat in the playground.
cards.example_zh: 一颗扣子在操场上从我的外套掉了下来。

cards.example_en: We met at a quiet café near school.
cards.example_zh: 我们在学校附近一家安静的咖啡馆见面。

cards.example_en: Students eat in the cafeteria.
cards.example_zh: 学生们在自助食堂吃饭。

cards.example_en: The bird flew out of the cage.
cards.example_zh: 鸟飞出了笼子。

cards.example_en: Calculate the total cost before you pay the cashier.
cards.example_zh: 付给收银员之前，先把总价算清楚。

cards.example_en: He practises calligraphy every Sunday.
cards.example_zh: 他每周日练书法。

cards.example_en: This small cake has about one calorie more than the apple.
cards.example_zh: 这块小蛋糕大约比苹果多一卡路里。

cards.example_en: A camel can go without water for days.
cards.example_zh: 骆驼可以好多天不喝水。

cards.example_en: The new campaign asks families to save water at home.
cards.example_zh: 新的运动号召家家户户在家里节约用水。

cards.example_en: New students toured the campus.
cards.example_zh: 新生参观了校园。

cards.example_en: Boats move slowly along the canal.
cards.example_zh: 船沿运河缓缓行驶。

cards.example_en: She is a candidate for class monitor this term.
cards.example_zh: 她是这学期班长的人选。

cards.example_en: The canteen serves rice and vegetables.
cards.example_zh: 食堂供应米饭和蔬菜。

cards.example_en: She is capable of running the whole project.
cards.example_zh: 她有能力管理整个项目。

cards.example_en: The hall has a capacity of five hundred people.
cards.example_zh: 这个大厅的容量是五百人。

cards.example_en: Take one capsule after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭后吃一粒胶囊。

cards.example_en: She was chosen as team captain.
cards.example_zh: 她被选为队长。

cards.example_en: Trees store carbon from the air.
cards.example_zh: 树木储存空气中的碳。

cards.example_en: She wants a career in medicine.
cards.example_zh: 她想从事医学工作。

cards.example_en: The red carpet in the hall looks very old.
cards.example_zh: 大厅里的红地毯看上去非常旧了。

cards.example_en: He can carve a bird from wood.
cards.example_zh: 他能用木头雕刻一只鸟。

cards.example_en: The cast of the play rehearsed all week.
cards.example_zh: 这部剧的演员阵容排演了一整周。

cards.example_en: The old castle stands on the hill.
cards.example_zh: 古老的城堡立在山上。

cards.example_en: Put each word in the right category.
cards.example_zh: 把每个词放进正确的类别。

cards.example_en: Cattle were grazing in the field.
cards.example_zh: 牛在田里吃草。

word.example_en: The secret is bound to come out.
word.example_zh: 这个秘密注定会传出去。

word.example_en: She is capable of leading the debate.
word.example_zh: 她能够胜任主持这场辩论。

word.example_en: She has a capacity for careful work.
word.example_zh: 她有做细致工作的才能。
